Hi Jorge —

Welcome! I'm Soojin in Procurement at Redwood Inference. We're excited to get Zendo Analytics set up so we can start issuing POs and get billing flowing. To kick off the vendor onboarding, can you please complete the attached Procurement_Intake_Form.xlsx and return the following as soon as possible: 

- Legal entity name (exactly as it should appear on the PO)
- Tax ID / EIN (or international tax identifier)
- Remit-to address for invoices
- Preferred payment method: ACH or Wire (if ACH, please provide bank name, account number, and routing number; if wire, include SWIFT/IBAN as applicable)
- Billing contact name + email for invoice submissions
- Any reseller/third-party billing arrangements we should know about
- Certificate of insurance (if applicable)

I've also attached our Vendor_Onboarding_Checklist which explains our PO flow, required fields, and typical SLA for vendor setup (usually 3–5 business days once we have complete documentation). A few quick notes on Redwood's PO process: we issue POs for all paid engagements, standard payment terms are Net-30 unless a different term is negotiated and approved by Finance, and invoices should reference the PO number we provide.

If you prefer, we can run through the form on a short call — I can loop in Aditya from Sales to align on initial POs.

Thanks, and looking forward to your response.

—
Soojin Lee

Hi Jorge —

Thanks for the quick turnaround and for attaching the W-9 and bank letter — that helps. A couple items from Finance to close out before we finalize setup: 

1) Can you confirm you prefer ACH for all invoices going forward? If you ever need a wire payment, please indicate at invoice time and include the SWIFT details for international wires.
2) Please confirm the remittance email for invoice submission: accounts-payable@zendoanalytics.com (we will use that on PO instructions).
3) For bank verification we use an embedded DocuSign token for micro-deposit verification for some vendors. If you prefer, you can accept the DocuSign verification here: https://redwood.app/docusign/embedded/abc123-bank-verification.

On POs: we typically issue single POs for defined projects or services and blanket POs for ongoing retainer/recurring work. There is no strict minimum invoice amount to receive a PO, but smaller one-off charges under $250 are sometimes processed via expense/credit card depending on the agreement with the owning team. Net terms are typically Net-30 (we can consider Net-45 with Sales approval).

If you can confirm ACH and the remit email, we'll proceed to create the vendor record and issue an initial PO.

Thanks,
Monica Patel
Senior Finance Manager | Redwood Inference
monica_patel@redwood.com
